text: 65-year-old male. The patient complains of persistent fatigue and reports poor sleep quality. He mentions adopting a vegetarian diet in recent months to improve his energy levels but hasn't noticed significant benefits. The patient reports losing weight without trying over the last month.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that history. To better understand your jaundice, have you noticed your urine turning dark like tea or your stools becoming pale/clay-colored?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fatigue. I also have Poor sleep quality, Unintentional weight loss, Jaundice.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hepatocellular Carcinoma. Given your age, significant unintentional weight loss, jaundice, and fatigue, this presentation is highly suspicious for liver cancer, likely arising from underlying chronic liver disease or cirrhosis. I strongly recommend immediate imaging to confirm the diagnosis and stage the disease. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdomen_CTC_with_contrast. REQUEST TEST: Liver_Function_Test. REQUEST TEST: Alpha_Fetoprotein.
